notes: Prices are estimates for the spend guard, in USD. Provider invoices win.
This project sends survey text to models, never imagery, and does no training.

reasoning_effort is per model; Spark defaults to minimal for short spoken turns. FIELD_AGENT_EFFORT_<SELECTOR> overrides it per run. A provider that answers 400 to a call carrying it gets one retry without it.
Fallback seats: on HTTP 402, 404 or 5xx, or a connection failure, a call retries once on its configured fallback. One hop per call at most. A 400 never falls back.
Glimmer is marked unavailable: it is not served serverless, and the client refuses before spending anything.

spark.tool_choice_note: Only "auto" is supported; "none", "required" and named choices return HTTP 400. Generated tool arguments are not guaranteed to validate against the schema.

prices.source: https://dev.meta.ai/docs/pricing-rate-limits (Muse Voice Transcribe, billed per whole second of audio)

glimmer.role: selectable agent model, inference only (inference only)

prices.source: https://fireworks.ai/models model library listing for Muse Glimmer 30B (uncached/cached/output per 1M tokens)

glimmer.unavailable: Fireworks reports supportsServerless: false for this model, so there is no serverless endpoint to call. It would need a dedicated deployment first.

spark-open-fw.role: selectable agent model (open weights, Fireworks serverless)
